verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own AI Editor lets users create and modify ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts. That is a first-party NL capability, but it covers only one narrow area rather than general operation of the platform. The other AI features (evidence gap analysis, AI-assisted due diligence, AI risk scoring) are automated analyses, not command interfaces. The GitHub compliance-skills are coding-agent skills for scanning codebases, not a way to operate Sprinto. Missing for 10: a general natural-language or chat interface for running platform actions (tasks, access reviews, vendor and audit workflows), documentation beyond ingestion workflow editing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
